song_craft: Lord-in-wandering song (9v; v14 absent in data — L4 follows L3 set): tended glory → actor-stages → shining-impure → confessed-incomplete → mirrored five → sung/called → glimpse-willing → graced veiling → jewel-near-clod. Confession inside exultation.

lines: Tended by seven knowers, by thirty-six in count —
he, great Lord: freedom's glory proceeds.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pramātṛsaptakatvena ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṅkhyayā bhāvitaḥ | sa maheśāno mokṣalakṣmīḥ pravartate

verses.craft: Tended means; glory proceeds; seven/36 count echoed from v09.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC []) / C1 essence / rasa relish-pattern / L2+L3 voice

lines: Its stages — views and the rest, all, no doubt;
made-up stages: as an actor takes his part by will, so bliss-spread self takes vast views-powers.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadbhūmikā darśanādyās sarvā eva na saṃśayaḥ | bhūmikāḥ kṛtrimā yadvan naṭo gṛhṇāti svecchayā

verses.craft: Made-up kept (kṛtrimā not false per UNC); actor simile kept whole.
verses.rejected: (a) false → killed by UNC. (b) cutting actor → killed: actor IS the made-up.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['kṛtrimā kept (made-up, not false).']) / C1 essence / rasa relish-pattern / L2+L3 voice

lines: Bliss-spread self, vast views-powers assumed, shines;
tightened own power in wandering — impure it grows.

verses.craft: Vast-assumed shines + tightened-impures in one breath (paradox uncut).
verses.rejected: (a) resolving paradox → killed: paradox is the verse.

lines: Incomplete — 'so I am, incomplete' — by assorted stains defiled,
māyā's, atom's, deed's by name — yet all-pervading too, world-Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: apūrṇo 'smīti vividhair malaiḥ | māyīyāṇavakārmākhyair vyāpako 'pi jagadvibhuḥ

l4.sanskrit_cite: vyāpī yadvan mahādevaḥ kroti pañcakṛtyatām | tadvad evāyam ātmāpi kurute śaktimohitaḥ

other power — keeping deemed; from loosing, withdrawn goddess deemed.
